bias_targets.methodology: Extracting internal representations (activation vectors) of LLMs processing persona-specific statements and applying dimensionality reduction (PCA) and pattern recognition (Deep Scan) to localize the encoding of political ideologies, including conservatism, liberalism, anti-immigration, and anti-LGBTQ-rights views.

Extracting internal representations (activation vectors) of LLMs processing persona-specific statements and applying dimensionality reduction (PCA) and pattern recognition (Deep Scan) to localize the encoding of ethical theories, such as utilitarianism, deontology, and virtue ethics.

Extracting internal representations (activation vectors) of LLMs processing persona-specific statements and applying dimensionality reduction (PCA) and pattern recognition (Deep Scan) to localize the encoding of the Big Five personality traits (agreeableness, conscientiousness, openness, extraversion, neuroticism).
